designationHistory.name: Fort Peck Game Range
designationHistory.indexText: Franklin D. Roosevelt signed Executive Order 7509 establishing the Fort Peck Game Range along the Missouri River in Montana for sharp-tailed grouse, pronghorn and other wildlife.
designationHistory.note: Later history per the CCP (not independently rechecked): renamed Charles M. Russell National Wildlife Range by Public Land Order 2951 (February 25, 1963); the Game Range Act (Public Law 94-223, February 27, 1976) placed it fully under the Fish and Wildlife Service as a refuge.
